question: After the merged flat session-thread work, what residual scope should #54397 continue to own: CLI/TUI management, richer topic metadata/import-export, or broader topic-family/project UI?
rationale: Current main solves several Web UI and chat-naming slices, but the remaining TUI, CLI, metadata, and import/export semantics require product/API ownership before implementation can be safely queued.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker and create narrower maintainer-scoped follow-ups for CLI/TUI management, metadata/import-export, and any topic-family model work.

options.title: Move Residuals Then Close
options.body: Close this broad issue only after maintainers create or designate canonical issues for each unresolved surface and link the partial Web UI implementation as complete for its slice.

options.title: Declare Web UI Scope Sufficient
options.body: Treat the landed picker/sidebar/session-thread work as enough for this request and explicitly leave CLI/TUI/import-export/topic metadata out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella tracker and create narrower maintainer-scoped follow-ups for CLI/TUI management, metadata/import-export, and any topic-family model work.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged session-thread management foundation and are the clearest current owner for deciding whether the remaining broad scope stays here or splits.
